Trump Praises Jeffries and Schumer, Sees Room For Deals With Democrats in 2027

President Donald Trump on Friday offered unusually warm praise for the top two Democrats in Congress and suggested that the incoming Democratic majority may prove easier to negotiate with than Republicans. Speaking to reporters in the briefing room, Trump described Hakeem Jeffries, who is poised to become the first Black Speaker of the House, as “streetwise” and “smart,” and also praised the current Senate Democratic leader Chuck Schumer, a striking change in tone …
